notes.title: Update on 64 Bit Engine
notes.content:
Dear Players,

As part of the community feedback we have received - We have updated the ENG region build of Fritz Chess 14 with the Fritz 14 engine for 64 bit machines. We would like you to let us know on the forums for this game if the engine has appeared for you. If it has, please let us know on the pinned post in the games forums and we will update the other builds with the 64 bit engine accordingly. Thank you all for your feedback regarding this application.
